title: Build COF and COF+adsorbate initial configurations
action: Construct initial atomic configurations for TAPT-TFPA COF in a 2×2 unit cell with 5 layers at incline angles 70°, 80°, 85°, 90°. Also generate configurations with inserted THF molecules at loadings 0, 30, 60, 112 and with H2O molecules at loadings 628, 780, 917. Output LAMMPS data files and input scripts.
description: Prepare all initial structures needed for the MD simulations.

title: Run pure COF MD simulations
action: Using LAMMPS with ReaxFF-lg force field, run NPT simulations (300 K, 1 atm) for pure COF at each incline angle for 5×10⁶ steps (0.1 fs time step). Store trajectory and log files.
description: Simulate pure COF to obtain equilibrium enthalpies.

title: Extract pure COF enthalpy vs incline angle
action: From the pure COF simulation logs, compute the average enthalpy per simulation cell after equilibration and write pure_cof_enthalpy.csv.
description: Enthalpy of pure COF as a function of incline angle. The agent must run the preceding process steps to obtain correct values.
output_schema: columns: incline_angle (degrees), enthalpy (kcal/mol). One row per angle.

title: Run COF+THF MD simulations
action: For each incline angle and each THF loading (n=0,30,60,112), run NPT simulations using the same settings as pure COF. Store log files.
description: Simulations of COF with adsorbed THF molecules.

title: Compute COF+THF operational enthalpy
action: From the COF+THF simulation logs, compute H₀(n) (enthalpy of COF with n THF). Then compute operational enthalpy H(n) = H₀(n) + (112-n) * h_THF, where h_THF is the enthalpy per liquid THF molecule. Write cof_thf_enthalpy.csv.
description: Operational enthalpy H(n) of COF+THF system per the paper's bookkeeping formula. Checked against Figure 3b.
output_schema: columns: incline_angle (degrees), n_THF (integer), enthalpy (kcal/mol). One row per angle and loading combination.

title: Analyze THF–COF interaction energy
action: From the same THF simulation trajectories, compute the average van der Waals interaction energy between THF molecules and the COF. Write cof_thf_interaction_energy.csv.
description: Average COF–THF vdW interaction energy. Compared to Figure 3c.
output_schema: columns: incline_angle (degrees), n_THF (integer), interaction_energy (kcal/mol). One row per angle and loading combination.

title: Run COF+H2O MD simulations
action: For each incline angle and each H2O loading (n=628,780,917), run NPT simulations using the same settings. Store log files.
description: Simulations of COF with adsorbed water molecules.

title: Compute COF+H2O operational enthalpy
action: From H2O simulation logs, compute H₀(n) and then operational enthalpy H(n) with water reference enthalpy h_H2O. Write cof_h2o_enthalpy.csv.
description: Operational enthalpy of COF+H2O. Compared to Figure 3d to see stability inversion.
output_schema: columns: incline_angle (degrees), n_H2O (integer), enthalpy (kcal/mol). One row per angle and loading combination.

title: Compute water O–O radial distribution function peaks
action: From equilibrated H2O simulation trajectories, compute the O–O radial distribution function g_OO(r) for each loading and incline angle. Extract the position and height of the first peak. Write cof_h2o_rdf_peak.csv.
description: First peak of O–O RDF to detect water ordering (hot ice). Compared to Supplementary Figure 7.
output_schema: columns: n_H2O (integer), incline_angle (degrees), first_peak_position (Angstrom), first_peak_height (arbitrary units). One row per condition.
